name: Shadow Priest Allister
summary: At the Sepulcher, Shadow Priest Allister directs Forsaken efforts across Silverpine Forest. He watches nearby threats and helps secure Lordaeron's borders for the Dark Lady.

sections.title: Watcher at the Sepulcher
sections.body: Shadow Priest Allister directs Forsaken scouts from the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest. From this settlement, he keeps watch for renegade humans, beasts, and the arcane activity around Dalaran.

sections.title: Eyes on Ambermill and Dalaran
sections.body: Allister's chief concern is the surviving mages of Dalaran, especially those at Ambermill who probe across the borders. He will not let the Kirin Tor gain a foothold in Forsaken lands. His agents intercept messengers, decipher arcane runes, and seek the wizards' long-term aims.

sections.title: Heretical Musings
sections.body: Allister's duties as a strategist share his attention with the study of shadow. He wrote 'Holy Bologna: What the Light Won't Tell You', a sharp attack on traditional holy doctrine. The book considers undeath's harsh realities and the Holy Light's failure to aid those cast aside by life. Somehow, copies have reached the ruins of Dire Maul in Kalimdor.

faq.answer: Shadow Priest Allister is a Forsaken priest at the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest. He coordinates surveillance and strikes against nearby threats, especially Dalaran's forces.

faq.q: Where can I find Shadow Priest Allister?
faq.answer: You can find Shadow Priest Allister at the Sepulcher, the main Forsaken settlement on the road through Silverpine Forest.

faq.q: Why is Allister focused on Dalaran and Ambermill?
faq.answer: The Kirin Tor mages at Ambermill threaten Forsaken territory. Allister works to decipher their communications, learn their intentions, and contain their influence.

aliases: what the light wont tell you
faq.answer: Allister wrote 'Holy Bologna: What the Light Won't Tell You', a sharp critique of the Holy Light that reached the ancient libraries of Dire Maul across the sea.
Allister offers several intelligence-gathering missions in Silverpine Forest, including Border Crossings, Maps and Runes, Ambermill Investigations, and work against Dalaran agents.

faq.q: Why does Allister practice Shadow magic instead of the Holy Light?
faq.answer: Like many Forsaken priests who felt abandoned by the Holy Light after death, Allister turned to shadow. He found power and resolve in a discipline that embraces undeath.

angles.text: As an Undead, you share Allister's ruthless pragmatism as he protects his people from the living.
As a Priest, you can see the Forsaken priesthood's disillusionment with the Light in Allister, author of 'Holy Bologna'.
As a member of the Horde, you share Allister's work to secure Silverpine Forest and keep the route between Tirisfal Glades and lands to the south safe for Horde allies.
